channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: O plano é livrar Vorcaro da cadeia depois de livrar Moraes de
item.description: A plan seeks to free Daniel Vorcaro from jail after removing Alexandre de Moraes from the investigation, using rapporteur disqualifications and tactics similar to those used against the Car Wash operation. The STF session was marked by criticism of judicial impartiality and institutional crisis ahead of elections.

item.title: Já vimos esse filme (por Mirian Guaraciaba)
item.description: Quaest released a poll favoring Flávio Bolsonauro after a meeting between its director and the candidate, while other institutes show Lula leading in the second round. The text questions possible manipulations and warns about press freedom.

item.title: Um dia após sessão do STF, Eduardo se reúne com governo Trump
item.description: A day after the STF halted the trial of Alexandre de Moraes, Eduardo Bolsonaro and Paulo Figueiredo meet with Trump administration officials in Washington to discuss investigations and Magnitsky sanctions.

item.title: A responsabilidade de Lula sobre a sessão que blindou Alexandre de Moraes no STF
item.description: During a Supreme Court session addressing investigations into Minister Alexandre de Moraes, the justices appointed by Lula, Cristiano Zanin and Flávio Dino, played key roles in a strategy that prevented the establishment of a formal inquiry. The strategy involved leaking sensitive data and introducing preliminary objections, causing chaos and halting the session. Lula subsequently distanced himself from Moraes during a press conference.

item.title: O Supremo pode ser juiz de sua própria crise?
item.description: The STF session on Petition 16.662, related to messages attributed to Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, ended without judging the merits, only deciding to separate the cases of André Mendonça. The case reveals institutional challenges of how the Court investigates its own justices. Elements mention suspicious payments involving relatives of ministers such as Kevin Marques and Rodrigo Fux, with companies denying irregularities.

item.title: Quaest: 49% não consideram Lula honesto; 42% dizem o mesmo sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: A Quaest poll reveals that 49% of Brazilians do not consider Lula honest, while 42% hold the same view toward Flávio Bolsonaro. Lula has 28% who view him as honest, compared to Flávio’s 23%. The survey, registered with the TSE, interviewed 2,004 people between September 10 and 13, with a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: JOTA Principal | STF não aponta saída para crise com vista de Dino que adia decisão sobre Moraes
item.description: The STF remained tense after Flávio Dino's request to postpone the decision on an investigation into Moraes, with no set date. The session exposed divisions among justices, marked by verbal confrontations and political alignments affecting the 2026 electoral landscape.

item.title: Julgamento de Moraes escancara guerra no STF, sem sinais de trégua
item.description: The Supreme Court trial regarding the investigation of Alexandre de Moraes remains tense with no signs of de-escalation. Despite Flávio Dino's request to set aside the case, justices confirmed their divergent positions, criticizing André Mendonça over the handling of the Banco Master inquiry. The case raises electoral tensions amid the upcoming election and involves figures such as Nunes Marques and Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: A ressaca cívica é porque a truculência e a chantagem venceram o argumento
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court meeting regarding the connections between Minister Alexandre de Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro was marked by aggression, blackmail, and rhetorical weapons rather than substantive debate. The ministers' behavior turned the session into a trial of the judges themselves, with leaks, convenient recusals, and attacks on figures such as Minister André Mendonça.

item.title: Renaut Geely anuncia investimento de R$ 1,9 bilhão no Brasil
item.description: Renault Geely do Brasil announces an additional investment of R$1.9 billion, raising the total planned between 2025 and 2027 to R$5.35 billion. The funds will support local production of electric models, including the Geely EX2 and a new Renault vehicle, strengthening the partnership between the French and Chinese automakers.

item.title: A audiência recorde da sessão histórica no STF
item.description: The STF's extraordinary session, which addressed a potential investigation of Minister Alexandre de Moraes regarding his ties with banker Daniel Vorcaro, became the most-watched video in the court's YouTube history, with 3.2 million views. The debate was interrupted after a motion by Flávio Dino, without progressing in the ruling.

item.title: Integrantes do Judiciário não podem ter parentes advogando, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated in an interview with Record that members of the judiciary, including Supreme Court justices, should not have relatives practicing law, emphasizing the need for 'moralization' of the judiciary and criticizing potential conflicts of interest. He also advocated for a deep reform of the judiciary, addressing issues such as term limits and selection criteria, highlighting the importance of the Supreme Court being a 'magnanimous example' for the country. His remarks were made amid proceedings involving justices Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça at the Supreme Court.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta quarta-feira (16)
item.description: On Wednesday (16th), the presidential candidates carry out their campaign schedule with rallies, processions, leafleting, and interviews on podcasts, radio, and TV, as well as meetings with supporters in various cities. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) stand out with events in CE and DF; other candidates such as Zema (Novo), Caiado (PSD), Samara Martins (UP), and Wilson Grassi (Democrata) are also mobilizing. Clariana Barão (DC), Rui Costa Pimenta (PCO), and Leonardo Avalanche (PRTB) do not disclose public schedules.

item.title: Sessão desastrosa do STF influenciará o voto e reduz confiança na democracia
item.description: A session plagued by personal conflicts and tactics to avoid decisions sparked criticism of the STF's management and reinforced 'civic unrest' voiced by Justice Cármen Lúcia. Debates over messages between justices and judicial procedures were postponed, polarizing views on institutional integrity.

item.title: Seleção feminina anuncia amistosos contra Argentina em Porto Alegre e Recife
item.description: The CBF announced friendly matches for the Brazilian women's team against Argentina on October 10 at Beira-Rio in Porto Alegre and October 13 at Arena Pernambuco in Recife. In November and December, Brazil will face Japan in Hiroshima and Okayama. Coach Arthur Elias highlighted Argentina's evolution and the challenge posed by Japan.

item.title: Vitória momentânea de Moraes e Fachin acuado: o saldo da sessão do STF sobre caso Moraes-Vorcaro
item.description: Judges aligned with Moraes, including Gilmar Mendes and Flávio Dino, voted 4 to 3 to postpone the trial of an action involving Moraes and Vorcaro, avoiding a direct clash with Justice André Mendonça. The session exposed Fachin's struggles to contain his colleagues' interventions, highlighting the strategic divide within the STF during a politically sensitive electoral period.

item.title: Agenda dos candidatos: Lula sanciona política para minerais e Flávio Bolsonaro visita Ceará e Pernambuco
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro lead separate campaign schedules in the Northeast and Federal District. The president signs a critical minerals policy and attends an event in Ceilândia; the senator tours CE and PE with rallies and walkabouts. Other candidates also hold interviews and regional events.

item.title: Imprensa internacional destaca crise no STF às vésperas das eleições
item.description: International press highlighted the crisis at the Brazilian Supreme Court ahead of elections, following a tense session over the potential investigation of Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The decision was postponed, adding uncertainty to an already polarized electoral context.

item.title: Com apoio de Eduardo, advogado de Zambelli leva Moraes ao Tribunal de Haia
item.description: Carla Zambelli's lawyer, Fábio Pagnozzi, filed a complaint against Justice Alexandre de Moraes at the International Criminal Court, backed by Eduardo Bolsonaro and Eduardo Tagliaferro. The accusation involves alleged arrests and political persecution of opponents, while the STF reviews investigations into the minister. Eduardo Bolsonaro also sought U.S. support for sanctions under the Magnitsky Act.

item.title: “Vaquinha” do Waze vira alerta para campanhas eleitorais nas ruas: entenda
item.description: Waze users have been using the 'cow' alert to indicate the presence of electoral campaigns on the streets, a practice identified in several Brazilian cities. Originally designed to warn about traffic obstacles, the feature is being repurposed to inform about political rallies and demonstrations. The newspaper sought a comment from Waze, but the company had not responded by the time of publication.

item.title: O advogado que faz a ponte entre Gilmar Mendes e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Lawyer Rodrigo Mudrovitsch, currently president of the Inter-American Court of Human Rights, serves as a bridge between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes, maintaining good relationships with both despite their opposing political paths. He was nominated to the Inter-American Court by Jair Bolsonaro in 2020 and has also worked as Gilmar's attorney in legal cases, in addition to teaching at IDP, an institution founded by Gilmar. There is speculation that Mudrovitsch could be nominated to fill Gilmar's seat on the Supreme Court in 2030 if Flávio wins the presidency in 2026.

item.title: Trump pierde en el Supremo la batalla del voto por correo, pero sigue su guerra para subvertir las ‘midterms’
item.description: Donald Trump lost a Supreme Court case regarding mail-in voting but continues attempting to influence the November legislative elections in the US. His strategy includes changing election rules and complicating ballot access, based on unfounded allegations of electoral fraud.

item.title: Campanha de Lula resgata histórico de Moraes para afastá-lo
item.description: Lula's campaign seeks to distance the president from the crisis involving Alexandre de Moraes at the STF by highlighting the minister's historical opposition to the PT before and after joining the Court. The strategy emphasizes that Moraes was appointed by Michel Temer and voted against Lula in 2018, reinforcing no political alignment. The government advocates for investigations into all involved in the Banco Master case without incorporating the crisis into the electoral campaign.

item.title: Dino anuncia prisões e deixa Brasília e advogados em alerta
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino stated he arrived late to the STF session because he was 'ordering arrests,' amid a surge in legal filings. His remark raised concerns among lawyers and officials in Brasília, particularly regarding ongoing cases under his oversight involving high-profile individuals.

item.title: Ministros do STF avaliam que crise na Corte pode afetar proposta de código de ética e alterar forças no caso Master
item.description: Supreme Court justices indicate that the institutional crisis within the STF may persist and affect the proposed ethics code and Edson Fachin's agenda, particularly regarding the Master case. Internal tensions worsened after the session discussing a possible investigation against Alexandre de Moraes, marked by communication blocks between justices and risks of further message leaks. The crisis may influence decisions in the Second Chamber and freeze discussions on judicial conduct rules.

item.title: VÍDEO: Até que horas posso votar na eleição 2026?
item.description: Voting in the 2026 elections starts at 8am and ends at 5pm Brasília time, but regions with different time zones have varying local times. Voters abroad must check specific hours set for each location. This is part of a 50-video series explaining electoral topics, campaign technologies, and voting procedures.

item.title: Pedido de vista trava julgamento no STF antes de analisar se Moraes deve ser investigado; entenda
item.description: The STF suspended the judgment regarding the potential investigation of Minister Alexandre de Moraes after a request for a vote by Minister Flávio Dino. The session ended without deciding whether the cases will be merged or kept separate, leaving the merits of the decision unresolved. The review deadline was extended to December 2024.

item.title: TV Globo e afiliadas entrevistam candidatos a governador em todo o Brasil; veja dias e como assistir
item.description: TV Globo and affiliates interview gubernatorial candidates nationwide starting September 14. Interviews air in state capitals with live streaming on g1 and Globoplay. Top contenders from major parties are featured.

item.title: Advogado de Vorcaro comemorou habeas corpus de Cláudio Castro
item.description: Lawyer Ciro Soares celebrated with businessman Daniel Vorcaro the habeas corpus granted to former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro, revealing conversations suggesting proximity between Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça, the lawyer, and the businessman. Soares served as an intermediary in meetings between Vorcaro and Mendonça in 2025, and his celebration sparked questions about potential judicial influence.

item.title: Em troca de mensagens, Fux manda Gilmar “não encher o saco”
item.description: Justice Gilmar Mendes clashed with fellow Supreme Court justices in WhatsApp messages, demanding institutional stances regarding the Federal Police case. Fux responded irritably, telling Gilmar not to 'bother him', while Kassio Nunes Marques blocked Gilmar after pressure to step down from hearings. The crisis involves investigations into alleged interference in the Lula administration and million-dollar contracts.

item.title: Marinho diz que STF blinda Moraes: “Isso é muito grave”
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) accused the STF of using procedural maneuvers to shield Minister Alexandre de Moraes by postponing a court decision on an investigation into him, via a review request from Minister Flávio Dino. Marinho defended Minister André Mendonça and criticized the mutual insults exchanged between Ministers Gilmar Mendes and Mendonça during the session.

item.title: O julgamento era sobre Moraes, mas Fachin virou o foco
item.description: During an extraordinary session of the Brazilian Supreme Court (STF) intended to rule on Alexandre de Moraes, the focus shifted to Justice Edson Fachin’s handling of the crisis, following criticism from justices like Gilmar Mendes and Flávio Dino. Fachin took over the rapporteur role in the fake news inquiry against Moraes and suspended parts of the investigations involving Justice André Mendonça, sparking debates on authoritarian risks and the court’s use of advocacy. The developments unfold amid growing internal polarization of the STF, with direct implications for Brazil’s legal and electoral landscape.

item.title: Lula diz que ninguém sob suspeita pode fugir do julgamento do STF
item.description: President Lula stated that no one under suspicion can escape judicial review at the STF, commenting on the analysis of a potential investigation of Minister Alexandre de Moraes in the Banco Master case. He advocated for lifting phone secrecy and investigating everyone involved without exception.

item.title: Damares diz que possível impeachment de Moraes não sairá neste ano
item.description: Senator Damares Alves stated that the impeachment process against Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes is unlikely to open in 2026 due to limited time and upcoming elections, expecting it to advance in February 2027 with the new legislature. She also advocated for Judicial reforms, including an ethics council for Supreme Court justices and changes to appointments and term limits for high court judges.

item.title: Crise no STF deve inviabilizar proposta de Fachin para código de conduta
item.description: Minister Edson Fachin's proposal to establish a code of conduct for Supreme Court justices was definitively rejected following a turbulent session on September 15, 2026. Justices and court observers consider the initiative unfeasible due to the ongoing institutional crisis. The proposal will not move forward in its original form.

item.title: Lula lidera em estados do Nordeste, e Flávio Bolsonaro avança no Sul e Centro-Oeste
item.description: Recent Datafolha and Quaest polls across Brazil's 27 states show President Lula (PT) leading in 10 states, while Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) holds advantages in nine states and the Federal District. The results highlight regional political polarization between the two candidates.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro cresceu e o PT tenta acordar
item.description: Quaest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading Lula in second-round simulation (42% to 40%), within the margin of error. He gains support from voters who previously criticized Lula 3.0.

item.title: Lula diz que Judiciário não pode causar desconfiança na sociedade
item.description: President Lula stated that the Judiciary should avoid causing distrust in society and advocated for investigations into the Master Bank case without distinction. He also called for a deep reform of the Judiciary, including changes to the term length of STF ministers.

item.title: STF tem incertezas sobre próximos passos dos casos Moraes e Mendonça; entenda
item.description: The STF suspends session to analyze potential investigation against Minister Alexandre de Moraes for connection with Daniel Vorcaro, former banker of Banco Master. The decision on whether to continue the investigation at the court remains unclear.

item.title: Lula cobra investigação sem distinção para STF recuperar credibilidade
item.description: Lula called for impartial investigations into all involved in the Banco Master case, stressing that the STF must restore credibility. He advocated for transparency and rigor in the probe, including authorities, and questioned the absence of justices in the suspended trial.

item.title: Julgamento expõe divisões no STF sem apontar solução para crise
item.description: The Supreme Court hearing exposed internal divisions without offering solutions to the political crisis. Minister Edson Fachin led the proceedings with a script that seemed inadequate for the gravity of the situation. The meeting highlighted the court's polarization without advancing concrete answers.

item.title: Kassio bloqueia Gilmar no WhatsApp após receber mensagem do decano: 'Assumam que estão ferrados'
item.description: Supreme Court minister Kassio Nunes Marques blocked Gilmar Mendes on WhatsApp after the latter pressured him to take a stance on a crisis. The tension reflects internal dissatisfaction within Brazil's highest court. The incident sparked speculation about ideological alignments among justices.

item.title: Lula tenta se afastar de STF e Moraes, e Flávio Bolsonaro busca carimbar crise no governo
item.description: Lula seeks distance from STF and Moraes crisis, while Flávio Bolsonaro criticizes the government crisis during a session regarding investigation into a minister involved in the Banco Master scandal.

item.title: 'Luta feroz': veja como a imprensa estrangeira noticiou o julgamento no STF
item.description: The STF hearing that may investigate Alexandre de Moraes sparked internal crisis at the court, drawing international attention ahead of October elections. Major foreign outlets highlight the clashes between justices and the severity of the situation.

item.title: Lula: Meu filho não tem proteção, só quero que ele tenha a igualdade que há para todos
item.description: In an interview with Record, President Lula stated that his son Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) has no special protection and will face legal consequences like any other citizen if he commits an offense. He emphasized his commitment to ensuring the equality enshrined in the law for all Brazilians, regardless of family ties.

item.title: Lula diz que Bolsonaro tinha ministros da Saúde 'mequetrefes' e abandonou setor
item.description: Lula called Bolsonaro's Health ministers 'mequetrefes' and criticized the previous administration for abandoning the sector. The statement was made during an interview on TV Record.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Dino e 'tropa de choque de Lula no STF' protegeram Moraes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the postponement of the STF decision regarding an investigation against Alexandre de Moraes, blaming Minister Flávio Dino and associating Moraes with President Lula. The PL candidate labeled Moraes as part of Lula's 'shock troops at the STF'.

item.title: Lula: Vamos anunciar na sexta um plano para a segurança do RJ ao lado do governador
item.description: Lula announced he will unveil a security plan for Rio de Janeiro on Friday, involving cooperation between federal, state, and municipal governments. The statement was made during an interview with TV Record.

item.title: Lula diz que BC independente não resolveu os problemas econômicos
item.description: Lula advocates for presidential interference in the economy and criticizes the independence of the Central Bank, stating that it does not solve the country's economic problems. In an interview with Record, the president emphasized the need for greater government control over national economic policies.

item.title: Dino lidera reação de grupo pró-Moraes, que tenta ganhar tempo e mira Fachin
item.description: Flávio Dino leads a reaction by STF ministers close to Alexandre de Moraes, criticizing procedures of Chief Justice Edson Fachin. The group aims to gain time and position itself ahead of the 2026 elections.
